rationale: The candidate reads as a coherent crossed bar-plus-perpendicular mass in all four views, so it avoids total fragmentation and has decent repair integrity. However, as a gymnasium it fails the hard semantic contract because the visible section does not convincingly communicate one clear long-span hall with a subordinate service spine and a legible roof/daylight expression. The mass is too diagrammatic and object-like, with almost no public void or entry ground response; the central intersection feels like a collision rather than an organized hall/service hierarchy. The stepped/profiled roof idea is present, but it reads more as arbitrary cross-massing than a usable gym section. Overall it is closer to a generic sculptural crossed volume than a gymnasium massing with clear span, entry hierarchy, and grounded public threshold.
